gaps.sentence: The letter arrived ___ due course — three weeks later.
gaps.hint: ___ due course = at the expected time
gaps.explanation: 'in due course' = at the proper time eventually.

gaps.sentence: ___ all appearances, the house had stood empty for years.
gaps.explanation: 'To all appearances' = as far as one can tell from looking.

gaps.sentence: The bus was so crowded that we travelled ___ discomfort.
The flat is ___ sale, but only to cash buyers.
The two versions differ in several ___ ; the ending is the biggest.
The scheme paid off in the ___ — we recouped every euro.
The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
___ theory the plan is sound; in practice it fails.
gaps.explanation: 'In theory' contrasts the idea with reality.
